bug_report: Rounded amounts no longer match the legacy billing ledger. Half-cent amounts round the wrong way — e.g. 2.125 should be 2.12 (the ledger value) but we are producing 2.13. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix the rounding so it matches the ledger again, without breaking existing behaviour.

conversations.text: Add a line-item discount to the invoice total and make sure the cents are right.
Done. I rounded the discounted total with banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) — that's the standard for money.

No, not banker's. In this project we round half-cents DOWN (ROUND_HALF_DOWN), always. Banker's and half-up both drift our totals away from the legacy ledger we reconcile against at month-end — finance flagged a 3-cent discrepancy last quarter from exactly this. Please use half-down for anything money-related here.
Got it — I'll use ROUND_HALF_DOWN for all money rounding in this project from now on, not banker's or half-up.
Thanks. Remember it, it keeps biting us.
